posts.message: Are you ready? Victorian Junior Rapid and Blitz Championship 2026

HBCC and Geelong Chess Club co-organised the 2026 Victorian Women's Championship under Chess Victoria. The club thanked Melissa Horne MP for presenting the awards and shared a gallery of the participants.
HBCC shared Star Weekly's recent coverage of the Victorian Women's Championship and the Victorian Junior Rapid and Blitz Championship, alongside Geelong Chess Club.
